args.subject: Request for Updated Billing Address – Refund Processing
args.body:
Dear Fabrikam Team,

Customer C-2316 (Fabrikam Ltd) has requested an update to their invoice contact address for refund processing. The current address in our records does not match the verified contact in the contract system. To proceed:

1. Please confirm the **new primary billing contact email** and address.
2. Specify any **additional authorized contacts** for invoice delivery.

**Refund Note:** A $175 late fee refund (policy RP-14) is pending and will be processed once the address is confirmed.

**Action Required:** Reply with the updated contact details within 2 hours or this ticket will be escalated to resolve the delay. Thank you.

*—IT Operations Team
